channel.title: Michael McIntyre's Big Show
channel.desc: The inimitable Jonathan Ross bravely hands over his phone for the starriest game of Send to All. Comedy's first couple, Chris and Rosie Ramsey, are rudely awakened for a Midnight Gameshow, while the legendary hitmaker Nile Rodgers, together with Chic, surprise some karaoke-singing members of the audience with special renditions of his classic hits in Nile-oke, before they raise the roof with a spectacular performance.
